title: LandslideFM: A Foundation Model Towards Unified Landslide Perception and Understanding
description:
arXiv:2611.12936v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Intelligent landslide detection is essential for disaster prevention. However, existing models primarily focus on isolated visual tasks, require extensive labeled data, and lack deep analytical and scene-understanding capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LandslideFM, the first unified foundation model that connects visual perception tasks with contextual interpretation of landslides.
